vignette: A parent brings in a child for a scheduled review of a permanent incisor that was injured recently. The child reports no pain, and the parent asks whether the visit is necessary.
stem: Which statement best describes what the follow-up visit should include?

options.text: It is mandatory and should include questioning about symptoms, clinical and radiographic exams, and pulp sensibility testing.
It can be omitted when the patient is asymptomatic.
It should rely on a radiograph alone, because sensibility testing is not part of follow-up.
It should consist of a clinical exam and sensibility testing, with radiographs avoided at follow-up.
